newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks lower in thin trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were steady to lower in shrinking trade on Thursday.
* Five of 11 active stocks fell, three rose and three were flat.
* Volume down 3,724 units, turnover shrank to 1.9 million kuna.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Suncani Hvar lost 3 kuna to 60 on volume of 115 shares.
* Biggest gainer textile firm Varteks inched up 8 kuna or 11 percent to 80, selling 51 shares.
* Most actively traded stock food processor Podravka held its ground at 295 kuna on volume of 1,567 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
